definitions.explanation: The price at which something was bought, or the price a buyer is willing to pay. Contrasts with {売|う}り{値|ね} (selling price).

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{値|ね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五万円|ごまんえん}だった。
{買|か}い{値|ね}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{売|う}れた→売れる：02012_ureru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to sell it for more than the purchase price.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{買|か}い{値|ね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}っている→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧。
examples.english: This stock is well below its purchase price.

notes:
A compound of {買|か}い (buying) + ⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧ (price). Refers to the price at which something was purchased or the price a buyer offers.

USAGE:
Used in both everyday and financial contexts. In stock and currency markets, {買|か}い{値|ね} is the bid price — the price a buyer is willing to pay.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買|か}い{値|ね}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{売|う}り{値|ね}: bid and ask prices
- {買|か}い{値|ね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧: to fall below the purchase price
- {買|か}い{値|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: to have a buying price set
- {買|か}い{値|ね}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell for more than the purchase price

SIMILAR WORDS:
{売|う}り{値|ね} (selling price / asking price).
